evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Synthetic Hospital, an open, fully synthetic, fact-grounded longitudinal EHR benchmark that resolves the open sharing and verifiable ground truth barriers.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Frontier language models are rarely used in clinical workflows because the realistic, longitudinal benchmarks needed to develop them are scarce.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 10 frontier and open models, none approaches ceiling: the best model reconstructs a patient's longitudinal problem list with a severity-weighted F1 of 0.73, level with the mean of seven physicians on a matched subset but well below the best of them (0.89), and misses roughly half of clinically relevant findings when summarizing a chart.
